alibabacloud-aisc-skill-inspection v0.0.2 changelog:

- Expanded documentation with detailed security check rules and user guidance in SKILL.md.
- Clarified natural language triggers for safety-related questions and requests.
- Added strict rules forbidding all pre-validation or downloading of user-provided URLs prior to submission.
- Explicitly defined allowed and forbidden behaviors for credential and API endpoint handling.
- Improved multi-file and endpoint handling instructions.
- Updated usage flow to separate Skill selection/loading from cloud API operation.
